terms_and_conditions_html:
MQlus Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

Terms & Conditions of the Organization

1. Work Timing & Attendance

Office Days

Monday to Saturday (6-day work week)

Working Hours

10:30 AM to 7:00 PM

Break Timings

  • Lunch Break: 2:00 PM to 2:45 PM
  • Evening Tea Break: 5:15 PM to 5:30 PM

2. Punctuality Rule (Strict Policy)

The official reporting time is 10:30 AM. A grace period of 10 minutes is allowed; therefore, employees may report until 10:40 AM.

Any arrival after 10:40 AM, even by one minute, will be considered a half-day, and 50% of the day's salary will be deducted.

Employees are not permitted to regularly report at 10:40 AM. This grace period may only be used 2–3 times per month.

If an employee is running late due to an urgent or valid reason, they must inform HR through a call or message in advance.

Employees must inform HR in advance through their official email ID for any half-day or full-day leave request. Otherwise, the leave will not be approved, and salary deduction will be applicable.


3. Attendance Punch-In & Punch-Out

It is mandatory for all employees to mark attendance while arriving at and leaving the office.

  • Employees must use the office phone to mark attendance.
  • If the office phone is unavailable, employees may use their personal phone.

4. Leave Policies

Half-Day Policy

Full-Time Employees

Employees must work at least 4 hours (excluding lunch break).

Part-Time Employees

Employees must work at least 3 hours.


Leave Requests

  • Planned leave must be applied for at least 8 days in advance, except in medical emergencies.
  • Leave requests must be sent via official email at least 24 hours in advance.
  • Failure to apply properly may result in leave rejection and deduction of two days’ salary.

Paid Leave

  • Employees are entitled to 2 paid leaves per month.
  • Unused leaves cannot be carried forward.

5. Remote Work Policy

Remote work is strictly not allowed.


6. Professional Conduct

Phone Usage Policy

  • The use of personal mobile phones for entertainment purposes—including watching reels, videos, web series, movies, gaming, or browsing social media—is strictly prohibited during working hours. Employees are expected to remain focused on their assigned responsibilities throughout their shift. Failure to comply with this policy may lead to disciplinary action as per company rules.
  • Excessive use of mobile phones during working hours is strictly prohibited.
  • Phones should be kept on silent or vibration mode while in the office.
  • Mobile phones should only be used for work-related purposes.
  • Personal calls, social media usage, or non-work-related activities should be avoided during office hours.
  • Misuse of mobile phones during work hours may result in disciplinary action.

Email Communication Policy

  • All employees must regularly check and respond to their official email ID for important work-related communication, including updates, announcements, and holiday notices.
  • All salary-related communication will be shared only through the employee’s official email ID.
  • HR will not share office-related or salary-related information through personal email IDs.
  • Employees will be responsible for any missed information due to inactivity on their official email account.

Professional Behaviour

Employees must maintain a professional and respectful attitude at all times.

Rude, disrespectful, or inappropriate communication with team members will not be tolerated.


7. Probation, Confirmation & Exit Policies

Training Period

  • The initial [7]-day training period is a paid training period. The training salary will be released along with the employee's third month's salary, subject to successful completion of the training period and continuation of employment.

Probation Period

  • The probation period will be 1 month.
  • No leaves are allowed during the probation period except for medical emergencies, which will be considered unpaid leave.

Confirmation Process

  • Candidates will receive the joining letter via email as confirmation of employment.
  • The offer letter will be provided after 15 days of joining the organization, including details of the salary package.

Resignation & Notice Period

  • Employees must serve a 45-day notice period, including Sundays and public holidays.
  • Any leave taken during the notice period will be unpaid, and the notice period will be extended accordingly.

If an employee fails to complete the notice period, the company reserves the right to:

  • Withhold the full and final settlement.
  • Withhold all exit documents.

Termination Clause

  • Management reserves the right to terminate employment without prior notice.
  • Employees are not permitted to resign without serving the required notice period.

8. Employment Terms & Bond Policy

Minimum Service Duration

Employees are not permitted to resign within the first 6 months of employment.

If they do so, management will not provide experience or relieving documents.


Bond Policy

Employees who are required to sign a bond must complete the process on the 10th of every month.


9. Salary & Payment Policy

Salary will be disbursed on the 10th of every month.


10. Language Policy

Communication Within Office Premises

Employees must communicate only in English or Hindi within the office premises.

The use of other languages is not permitted in order to maintain a professional and inclusive work environment.


11. Mandatory Document Submission

Employees must submit the following documents at the time of joining:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • PAN Card
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Degree certificates and mark sheets
  • Relieving letter and last 3 months’ salary slips from the previous company (if experienced)

Bank Account Details

  • Account Number
  • Bank Name
  • Branch Name
  • IFSC Code

12. Overtime Policy

Eligibility for Overtime

Employees will be eligible for overtime only if they work beyond office hours with prior approval from both co-founders.

Official office timings are 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM.

Overtime will only be considered if an employee works beyond 7:30 PM for genuine work assigned by the co-founders.


Overtime Duration & Conditions

  • To qualify for overtime, employees must work an additional 45–60 minutes beyond 7:30 PM.
  • Overtime will not be considered for self-assigned work or voluntary late sitting.

Overtime Calculation

Overtime will be calculated based on the employee’s monthly salary converted into a daily wage.

For Full-Time Employees

Overtime Pay = (Monthly Salary ÷ Working Days in a Month ÷ 8.5) × Overtime Hours

For Part-Time Employees

Overtime Pay = (Monthly Salary ÷ Working Days in a Month ÷ 5) × Overtime Hours


Approval & Documentation

Employees must send an email to HR requesting overtime approval.

Overtime will only be approved after confirmation from both co-founders through HR.
